text:
maria: Hey — spotted odd routing in prod around 02:00 UTC. workspace header set to `acme-prod`, request came in from their private VPC endpoint, but it landed on the shared public pool.
aj: ugh. any error in gateway logs?
maria: gateway shows `match: headers.X-Workspace=acme-prod` matched, then `policy: route-to-pool: public` evaluated. there's an extra header `X-Pool-Hint: public` from their side SDK.
sam: so SDK is sending a pool hint that overrides vpc binding? we intentionally prioritized header hints last month.
liz: we patched hint precedence to be higher for quick rollouts — maybe that change is the cause.
aj: which change exactly? PR #3246?
liz: yes. we flipped `hint_precedence=true` because it eased canaries but didn't account for VPC-enforced pool binding.
david: infra-bot:trace-id=8c9a7b — here's the decision path:
```
match workspace header -> true
check vpc-binding -> true (tenant-bound to dedicated-us-east)
apply hint precedence -> X-Pool-Hint=public overrides -> route to public
```
maria: That's the split-brain: workspace scope says dedicated, VPC asserts dedicated, but header hint forced public. We need a deterministic precedence to avoid data isolation breaches.
aj: Agreed. Proposal: authoritative sources order = (VPC endpoint binding) > (workspace/account config) > (admin overrides) > (client hints). Client hints only used for dev-mode.
sam: That sounds safe. Downside: hurts on-the-fly canaries where we rely on hints for rollouts.
liz: For canaries we can use a signed override header from our rollout service (internal only) e.g., `X-Redwood-Rollout: canary-v2;sig=...` and treat it as admin override.
david: +1 as long as signature verification is required and logged.
aj: Telemetry ask: add a routed-by tag to trace/span (values: vpc, workspace-config, admin-override, hint) so we can query how often hints win.
maria: also add an isolation-safety flag on logs when the chosen route is incompatible with any stronger binding (e.g., when vpc says dedicated but we route public) — that should trigger alerting.
infra-bot: alert created: #ops: routing-override-safety (severity: high) for occurrences > 1/min per workspace.
sam: Ops alert is good. Implementation plan: revert PR that flipped `hint_precedence` to true, then deploy the signed-rollout approach.
liz: I can revert and open follow-up to add signed header. Rolling back now in canary.
maria: Thanks. Follow-ups: (1) add `routed_by` span attribute; (2) log `isolation_conflict=true` when mismatch detected; (3) update docs for precedence; (4) add test for VPC+header conflict.
aj: I'll own telemetry dashboards for the `routed_by` breakdown and will add an alert if `hint` > 0.1% on dedicated workspaces.
david: quick config snippet for the precedence rules we should enforce:
```
precedence:
  - vpc_binding
  - workspace_policy
  - admin_override
  - signed_rollout_override
  - client_hint
```
maria: Perfect. One more UX note: Console should surface when a workspace has VPC-binding and show recent `isolation_conflict` events on the workspace page so customers can see weirdness.
liz: Will add to Console backlog (ticket CON-788).
sam: Thanks. Anything else?
maria: No, keep me posted. If you see other workspaces affected, post in #incidents. :eyes:
